method: Every page of the extraction was compared with its printed page image by an AI reader (one per chapter). About 980 corrections were proposed; spelling rules fixed 205 of them everywhere they occur; 180 plain word slips were accepted by a corpus check; 568 were re-read by a second AI reader on 200 dpi page halves (546 confirmed, 5 rejected, 17 unsure) and only the confirmed ones were applied. This is a machine reading, not human review.

residualCheck.note: A fresh, unprompted check of random pages (3 per chapter) after all corrections were applied.
residualCheck.meaningChangingWere: the term সম্পৃক্ত / অসম্পৃক্ত (saturated / unsaturated) garbled twice in one passage pair
residualCheck.followUp: All 11 were fixed. About 4% of passages in the sample had a spelling error; about 1% had one that changes meaning, before the fix.

excluded.why: The parser turned graphs into tables of values that are not in the book.

knownGaps: Section and sub-section headings are missing from the passages; section labels are unreliable and are not used for retrieval.
About 20 figures have a wrong, cropped or missing picture file; text that points to a figure whose picture is missing is flagged (missingFigures).
An estimated 3-4% of passages still carry a spelling error; no human has read the book.
Digits are normalised to Bangla in prose; the printed book often uses Latin digits.
